name: Dashboard Graphs for WooCommerce
author: KNEET

sections.description:
Dashboard Graphs for WooCommerce adds a new dashboard widget to your WordPress dashboard that displays a stacked bar chart with sales data per product category.

Features:
* Stacked bar chart with sales data per category
* Choice between last 7, 14 or 30 days
* Automatic color coding per category
* Responsive design
* Shows only categories with sales

Translations

This plugin is available in the following languages:
* Dutch (nl_NL)
* Dutch (Belgium) (nl_BE)
* German (de_DE)
* French (fr_FR)
* English (en_US)

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wc-graphs directory
  2. Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to your WordPress dashboard to see the new widget
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to function.

What WordPress version do I need?

Minimum WordPress 5.0.

What PHP version do I need?

Minimum PHP 7.2.
